comments.author: JamesMowery
comments.body_html:
One suggestion that I (and I think many others) would love to see is the ability to just have a global generic loot icon that you could enable that replaces all the other loot icons. The reason is so that it doesn’t spoil the contents of what loot there is (so that it is still exciting and a mystery as to what kind of loot you will potentially get).

Maybe could just be a single checkbox: “Use generic loot icon” and when enabled we will have a single color setting below for that specific icon (could just be a generic box icon or a generic dot or something), and have that generic icon be used everywhere for all loot while not showing any other existing icons (I’m sure you could just simulate setting the alpha transparency for all other loot icons as a quick hack if that is easiest; or just have the single icon replace all the existing icons and overwrite the existing color settings for that one specified).

Either way, getting this updated is very much appreciated!

comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html:
The icons are already limited, for containers/bodies it will only ever be default, wishlist, or non-flea (if enabled). The only marker type that actually shows an item-specific marker is loose loot, which isn’t really spoiling anything as you can already see the loot

The color of the label will vary based on the quality of the item in the container, but you can already change that yourself by just setting all colors to be the same

comments.author: JamesMowery
comments.body_html:
Ah I didn’t realize that. I guess me noticing the <3 icon on filing cabinets for the wishlist was too much of a giveaway for me.

For loose loot, I suppose it makes sense logically (although, I admit, I still would much prefer the mystery of still having to look at it closely).

I guess then I could simplify the request to just have a toggle to disable showing wishlist specific icons on containers/bodies/loose loot! That one, especially when your going through filing cabinets, is extremely hard to avoid in particular.

(And for sure I already set everything to just be pure white!)

Either way, thanks so much!

comments.author: JamesMowery
comments.body_html:
It’s a massively useful feature to me. I have some vision impairment (cataracts). But, even beyond that, I’ve never played EFT before. And I’ve only ever played 2 maps on SPT so far (and I’ve probably only seen like 30 - 40 % of those maps). And, to be honest, I just don’t have the time/drive available (like I used to) to pay too much attention to every little thing.

The reason I enjoy playing EFT is the loot. I suck at shooting games, so the loot is the main appeal to me. So yeah, for people like me, who like the thrill of looting and finding something special (but also have trouble finding where stuff is in general), I think it would be a great future to add (just a simple option to ensure the mystery of the contents is maintained).

I wish I knew how to code. I’d 100% submit the code to make this an option in a heartbeat.

But yeah, I’m just happy to have anything at all. But I still think this would be a very nice thing to have. Maybe one day! Either way, very happy to have Sense back in the game. I can finally play. :)
